criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: Participation
categories.definition: One entity is involved in or part of an event, organization, or activity related to the other entity.

categories.name: Creation
categories.definition: One entity is the creator, designer, or originator of the other entity.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: One entity is a geographical location or place associated with the other entity.

categories.name: Authorship
categories.definition: One entity is the author or writer of the other entity, typically a written work.

categories.name: Ownership
categories.definition: One entity owns, possesses, or has a controlling interest in the other entity.

categories.name: Representation
categories.definition: One entity represents or is a symbol of the other entity.

categories.name: Membership
categories.definition: One entity is a member or part of the other entity, typically an organization or group.

categories.name: Naming
categories.definition: One entity is named after or shares a name with the other entity.

categories.name: Family
categories.definition: One entity is a family member or relative of the other entity.

categories.name: Employment
categories.definition: One entity is employed by or works for the other entity.

categories.name: Competition
categories.definition: One entity competes against or is a competitor of the other entity.

categories.name: Award
categories.definition: One entity is an award or recognition received by the other entity.

categories.name: Education
categories.definition: One entity is an educational institution attended by the other entity.

categories.name: Influence
categories.definition: One entity influences or inspires the creation or development of the other entity.

categories.name: Historical Event
categories.definition: One entity is a historical event or period associated with the other entity.

categories.name: Product
categories.definition: One entity is a product or result of the other entity.

categories.name: Collaboration
categories.definition: One entity collaborates or works together with the other entity.

categories.name: Publication
categories.definition: One entity is a publication or media outlet that features or is associated with the other entity.

categories.name: Performance
categories.definition: One entity performs or is featured in a performance related to the other entity.

categories.name: Cultural
categories.definition: One entity is culturally or traditionally associated with the other entity.
